notes: The supplied *with* before *marrow and fatness* is the preposition the English predicate *be satisfied with* needs to reach the complement of the elided comparative member, not part of כְּמוֹ's rendering. Rule 25's example (*search for her as for hid treasures*) gives such a word to the verb while the comparative preposition keeps only *as*; the subtraction test rules 16, 31 and 44 run agrees. Moved *with* from כְּמוֹ to תִּשְׂבַּע; all other edges unchanged.
